newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stocks end down on futures-related trade.
newsitem.headline: S.African stocks end down on futures-related trade.

text.p: South African industrial shares ended weaker on futures-related activity and gold shares slumped amid poor gold quartely results and a lacklustre bullion price.
Dealers said the market had expected a Wall Street to firm on Tuesday night and futures players were caught long on Wednesday following falls on the U.S. market.
Profit-taking, worries on a weaker rand and concern over further weakness on Wall Street on Wednesday all nudged the market lower, they said.
The overall index ended down 50.2 points to 7,022.9, the industrial index lost 45.8 points to 8,260.2 points and the gold index shed 28.4 points to 1,695.1 points.
